context_diary: The account_lookup class provides lookup_account function that can filter by account type and return specific fields, with result limits enforced while still providing total match counts. The hierarchy_management class provides traverse_hierarchy function that can query relationships in both parent and children directions, returning direct reports with count metadata showing total matches. The hierarchy system supports multi-level structures where agents can have both users and other agents as direct reports, enabling nested team structures. When traversing children from an agent, the function returns all direct subordinates including mixed types (USER and AGENT), allowing identification of team leads who manage other agents versus those who only manage end users. The account_lookup function supports wildcard field selection via asterisk to retrieve complete profiles without enumerating individual fields, and can filter by assigned_agent relationships to find accounts linked to specific agents in the hierarchy. The lookup_account function can filter by assigned_agent to find all accounts linked to a specific agent, and when combined with account_type filtering, can isolate just users or just subordinate agents under a given agent.
